title: Gil's own drinking, a quart a day
summary: Gil says he drank a quart a day for years during and after Prohibition, and says it does not necessarily wreck a person.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, he used to drink. I used to drink too. I used to drink a quart a day at one time.
Did that account for your disappearing for years? (LAUGHTER). As the interviewer said in that article. (LAUGHTER).
No, but it didn't seem like much
to be drinking you know. I didn't drink it by myself. Well of course, prohibition was still in when I started. But you can drink a quart a day and not really be.....
I mean you're up half the night.
All you can do is ruin your liver, you could die.
